content.comment_body: Hi, I'm new to this software and need some help. I'm developing a washing machine program and have most things set up, but I want to reset everything automatically once the final step finishes. After the machine completes its process, the entire program should go back to the starting point. Any advice would be much appreciated!
Hello, To assist you better, we need to review your program. Please attach it to your post. Regards,
Here's a picture of my program since I'm unable to upload this file type.

What do you want to happen? Should the program exit completely from the [product_name]? So you would need to reprogram it? Or should it start again from the beginning? Please share your program as a zip file containing the .LSC version.
I've uploaded the zip file. My goal is to have the program reset itself so that after it finishes, pressing start allows another cycle. Thanks!

When is your program completed? That's not entirely clear from what you've shared. In your program, set a marker that is activated when the last step finishes. Connect this marker with an OR logic in parallel to input I2 (Stop) and to the reset input of your RS relays.
Hello, If your program ends when q4 turns off, refer to the attachment. I included T5 because q4 goes high briefly when i3 is activated. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: New users encounter challenges when trying to set up a complete reset function in their washing machine control program with the software. There are difficulties with communicating program logic, and unfamiliarity with best practices for implementing automatic reset behaviors can add complexity for those new to programming these devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to reset their washing machine program so the system returns to its initial state, making it easy to immediately start a new cycle after completion without manual intervention or rewriting the program.
